capabilities.sectionSummary: Engineered polymer properties verifying outdoor durability, color retention, and multi-substrate protection in harsh climates.

items.title: UV Resistance
items.description: Saturated acrylate elastomer replaces unsaturated butadiene rubber, preventing photo-oxidative chain breakdown under direct solar radiation.

items.title: Color Stability
items.description: Heat-stable inorganic pigments and spectrophotometer calibration preserve gloss and shade uniformity without fading or chalking.

items.title: Weather Resistance
items.description: Maintains structural impact strength and thermal dimensional stability across high-heat desert summers and coastal humidity.

items.title: Corrosion Resistance
items.description: Chemically inert against coastal salt mist, industrial acid and alkali vapors, and moisture where painted steel rusts and peels.

items.title: Wide Range of Colors
items.description: Supplied across 13 certified ERP codes covering 10 ASA Film (Top) exterior shades and 3 ASA Film (Bottom) backing shades plus custom RAL matching.

stages.title: Raw Material Preparation
stages.description: Weighing virgin ASA terpolymer resin, saturated acrylate modifiers, UV stabilizers, and inorganic pigments, followed by moisture-controlled drying before feeding.

stages.title: Material Processing
stages.description: High-shear twin-screw compounding and melt filtration ensure uniform pigment dispersion and controlled polymer rheology free of unmelted gels.

stages.title: Extrusion Process
stages.description: Precision flat-die and multi-layer feedblock extrusion forms uniform ASA surface films or co-extruded capstock fused directly onto UPVC cores.

stages.title: Surface Treatment
stages.description: Temperature-regulated chrome and embossing rollers impart consistent surface gloss, fine architectural pebble texture, or low-glare matte finish.

stages.title: Quality Inspection
stages.description: Every lot undergoes thickness micrometer checks, spectrophotometer color validation, Charpy impact testing (ISO 179), and QUV weathering qualification.

stages.title: Final Product Packaging
stages.description: Film rolls, 25 kg resin bags, and corrugated panels are wrapped in sealed barrier layers with batch traceability labels for safe warehouse storage and transport.

workflow.title: Sample-to-Application Engineering Workflow
workflow.subtitle: Verify thermal, adhesive, and color compatibility on your own production line before bulk supply.

steps.title: Specify Requirements
steps.detail: Share your target application, base substrate (PVC, UPVC, ABS, or metal lamination), required thickness, width, and RAL or catalogue color code.

steps.title: Review Physical Sample
steps.detail: We dispatch physical ASA film rolls, resin granule batches, or corrugated sheet cut-samples from Sadat City for visual and lab inspection.

steps.title: Production Line Compatibility Test
steps.detail: Run extrusion, thermoforming, or lamination trials on your machinery to verify melt temperature (185 to 215 °C) and peel strength.

steps.title: Confirm Order & Scheduled Supply
steps.detail: Lock batch specifications, quality inspection criteria, and export-protected packaging for scheduled factory delivery.

criteriaList.label: 01. End-Use Environment
criteriaList.value: Roofing tiles, exterior wall cladding, window profiles, automotive trim, or outdoor enclosures.

criteriaList.label: 02. Base Substrate Material
criteriaList.value: Rigid UPVC, foamed PVC, ABS, or steel composite requiring thermal expansion matching.

criteriaList.label: 03. Thickness & Roll Width
criteriaList.value: 0.15mm to 0.50mm for films and capstock, or 1.50mm to 3.50mm for solid and corrugated sheets.

criteriaList.label: 04. Color & Gloss Level
criteriaList.value: High-gloss, satin matte, or embossed surface textures matched to RAL or custom masterbatch.

criteriaList.label: 05. Adhesive & Thermal Window
criteriaList.value: Direct thermal co-extrusion bonding or hot-melt lamination compatibility at 185 to 225 °C.
